newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudi barley tender results expected Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Saudi barley tender results expected Wednesday.

text.p: Offers have gone in during the last hour for a major Saudi barley tender for one million tonnes that is expected to set the direction for world prices.
Saudi Arabia, the world's largest importer of the grain with annual needs of around five million tonnes, is seeking optional-origin barley for September and October arrival.
Traders said the tender deadline closed at 1500 GMT and results were not expected before Wednesday.
The tender is the kingdom's first major purchase of new-crop barley.
Riyadh last month bought 700,000 tonnes of barley for arrival by July 15 at prices estimated between $163.50 and $173.50 per tonne including freight.
Traders estimated those prices at around $143 to $153 per tonne fob.

Barley is currently indicated closer to $130 per tonne fob, though few clear quotes are available for the European Union, Saudi Arabia's largest supplier, since Brussels is currently out of the export market and subsidy policy remains unclear.
